GHA.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
No government body is stated to pilot or use an AI system; the centre is planned.
Healthcare AI is an intention only, no tool is piloted or in service.

facts.fact: Finance Minister Ato Forson said the 2027 Budget presented on 12 November 2026 allocates US$300 million over 2027-2028 to establish a National AI Centre (with a rural 2G-to-4G upgrade), to provide shared high-performance computing, secure data environments and model-testing infrastructure.

systems.owner: Government of Ghana (Ministry of Finance budget)

GHA.note: Centre support for start-ups is a plan, not a startup law, label or fund.
No hub, incubator or park with programmes is stated.
